verdict.rationale: Exporting data and leaving is a fair question for an infrastructure control plane. Crossplane's own docs say its configuration is written in open formats such as YAML (docs-2), its declarative APIs are machine-readable (docs-29), and Configurations are portable packages of resources (docs-11); a community user notes the YAML is easy to commit to source control (comm-10). That shows open formats but no documented export or exit path. Missing for 10: a documented full-data export capability, guidance on migrating off Crossplane (e.g. state of managed resources), and independent or hands-on corroboration of leaving cleanly.
